nodes.name: Receive Input
nodes.notes: FIXED: was a plain Manual Trigger, which has no formal input contract and could not actually receive workflow_run_id/topic from the Main Orchestrator's Execute Workflow node. Now an Execute Workflow Trigger, matching every other sub-workflow. Can still be run standalone by pinning sample data on this node.

nodes.name: HTTP Request - Trend Source (Placeholder)
nodes.notes: PLACEHOLDER endpoint only — no real trend/research provider is wired in yet. Point this at a real source (YouTube Data API, Google Trends proxy, a news API, etc.) when one is chosen. This node intentionally does not call any AI/LLM provider. TODO: external trend-source provider still undecided — URL stays an example.com placeholder (not a backend route, so not swapped to host.docker.internal). retryOnFail added since this is a network call to an eventual third-party API.

nodes.name: Extract Results
nodes.notes: Pulls the relevant array out of whatever shape the placeholder HTTP node returns. Field names (items/results) are guesses to be adjusted once a real trend-source API response shape is known.

nodes.name: Normalize Data
nodes.notes: Pure data normalization — no AI/LLM calls. Guarantees a non-empty research_data array even when the placeholder HTTP source returns nothing.

nodes.name: Return JSON
nodes.notes: FIXED: previously only returned research_data, silently dropping workflow_run_id. Now returns { workflow_run_id, research_data } — consumed by the Main Orchestrator's Execute Workflow node.

meta.notes: Sprint 1-3 scaffold sub-workflow. The HTTP Request node points at a placeholder URL — no real trend/research source is wired in yet, and no AI/LLM provider is called anywhere in this workflow. Output contract: a single top-level 'research_data' array field, intended to be called via Execute Workflow from 'Arya OS - Main Orchestrator'.
